input_audio.description: Absolute path to an audio file (any format soundfile/ffmpeg reads).

trim_silence.description: Cut leading/trailing silence (useful for one-shot SFX).

mono.description: Downmix to mono (common for positional game SFX).

normalize.description: none = only the safety ceiling; peak = scale so the peak hits peak_ceiling_db; loudness = EBU R128 to target_lufs, two-pass, linear gain when the true-peak limit allows it, otherwise ffmpeg's dynamic mode (reported as loudnorm_mode); the peak ceiling is applied afterwards.

target_lufs.description: loudness mode: -14 streaming/video, -16 game BGM, -23 broadcast. SFX are usually peak-normalized instead.

loop.description: Make a seamless loop by crossfading the tail into the head (output gets shorter by loop_crossfade_ms).

loop_crossfade_ms.description: Loop crossfade: ~50–200 ms for rhythmic BGM cut on a bar, 500–2000 ms for ambience.

format.description: wav = 24-bit PCM; ogg = Ogg Vorbis (Unity/Godot); flac = 24-bit lossless.

sample_rate.description: 48000 for video; 44100 keeps the model's native rate (no resampling).
